slides.title: The Problem — Pakistan's Healthcare Gap
slides.task_brief:
PROBLEM SLIDE — White background. 

HEADER (padding 48px 64px 24px): 
- Small pill: 'THE PROBLEM' in rose pill
- H1 title in 36px Inter Bold: 'Pakistan faces a critical healthcare access crisis'
- Subtitle in 18px, muted slate: '240 million citizens. A system stretched beyond capacity.'

BODY: 4-column stat grid (gap 20px, padding 0 64px):

1. Card with rose left-border (4px). Big number '1:1,300' in 52px JetBrains Mono, rose color. Label: 'Doctor-to-patient ratio' in 14px. Sub-label: 'WHO recommends 1:1,000' in 12px muted.

2. Card with rose border. Big number '60%' in 52px, rose. Label: 'Lack access to formal healthcare'. Sub: 'Rural & low-income majority'.

3. Card with amber border. Big number '70M+' in 52px, amber. Label: 'Urdu-first speakers'. Sub: 'Excluded by English-only tools'.

4. Card with amber border. Big number '<5%' in 52px, amber. Label: 'Health budget of GDP'. Sub: 'Among lowest globally'.

BELOW THE GRID (padding 24px 64px): A wide alert card with rose background (#ffe4e6), rose left border 6px. Icon 'warning' in rose. Text: 'When emergencies strike — cardiac arrest, stroke, maternal hemorrhage, severe bleeding — every second counts. But most Pakistanis don't know the warning signs, and there's no trilingual, offline-capable triage tool to guide them.'

FOOTER: Left: 'SehatAI · Problem Statement', Right: '02 / 12'

Speaker notes: The gap isn't just doctors — it's language, literacy, and the absence of any safety net for the moment when seconds determine survival.

slides.title: Our Solution — SehatAI
slides.task_brief:
SOLUTION SLIDE — White background with subtle gradient-mesh overlay.

LEFT COLUMN (55%, padding 64px 32px 64px 64px):
- Pill: 'OUR SOLUTION' in emerald
- H1 in 38px Inter Bold: 'A trilingual, offline-capable AI health companion that puts safety first'
- Body paragraph in 16px: 'SehatAI is a Progressive Web App that provides immediate, evidence-grounded health guidance in English, Urdu (اردو Nastaliq), and Roman Urdu. Unlike generic chatbots, it uses a deterministic-first safety architecture — emergencies are detected in under 100 milliseconds and bypass the LLM entirely, displaying pre-verified WHO action cards with one-tap dialing to 1122, 1166, and 115.'
- 4 feature bullets with Material Icons in emerald circles (40px):
  • icon 'shield' — 'Deterministic safety engine detects 28 emergency patterns in <100ms'
  • icon 'translate' — 'Full trilingual support with RTL layout for Urdu Nastaliq'
  • icon 'wifi_off' — 'Offline safety pack works without internet'
  • icon 'verified' — 'Every response grounded in WHO, UNICEF & MoNHSRC citations'

RIGHT COLUMN (45%, padding 64px 64px 64px 32px): A phone mockup (rounded 32px, dark slate frame, 320px wide, 560px tall) showing a chat interface. Inside: 
- Top bar: 'SehatAI' with green dot 'online'
- A user message bubble (slate bg): 'Mera seenay mein dard ho raha hai' (Roman Urdu)
- An emergency card (rose bg, white text): icon 'warning' + 'Mumkina dil ki emergency' + 'Fori 1122 par call karein' + 3 action bullet points + a green call button '1122'
- Below the phone, a small caption: 'Emergency detected in 67ms — LLM bypassed, deterministic template shown'

FOOTER: Left: 'SehatAI · Solution Overview', Right: '03 / 12'

Speaker notes: The key insight — for life-threatening emergencies, an LLM is a liability. We short-circuit it entirely and show pre-verified action cards in the patient's language.

slides.title: Safety Architecture — 5-Layer Pipeline
slides.task_brief:
ARCHITECTURE SLIDE — Dark slate background (#0f172a), white text.

HEADER (padding 48px 64px 24px):
- Pill: 'SAFETY ARCHITECTURE' in emerald pill
- H1 in 34px white: 'Five-layer safety pipeline — every response is screened, grounded, and validated'

BODY: A horizontal pipeline of 5 connected stage cards (padding 0 48px, gap 16px). Each card is 200px wide, 340px tall, dark-soft bg (#1e293b), rounded 16px, with a number badge at top.

STAGE 1 — Badge 'L0' in rose circle. Icon 'flash_on' rose. Title 'Safety Lexicon' in 16px white bold. Body in 12px slate-300: '28-pattern deterministic engine. Detects cardiac, stroke, maternal, pediatric, poisoning emergencies in <100ms. Matches across English, Urdu & Roman Urdu.' Latency badge: '<100ms' in rose.

Arrow (emerald, material icon 'arrow_forward') between cards.

STAGE 2 — Badge 'L1' in amber. Icon 'category' amber. Title 'Triage Classifier'. Body: 'Routes to EMERGENCY / URGENT / ROUTINE / SELF_CARE. Decouples chief complaint from danger signs to prevent false escalation.' Badge: '4 levels'.

Arrow.

STAGE 3 — Badge 'RAG' in sky. Icon 'search' sky. Title 'Grounded Retrieval'. Body: 'Token-boundary matching across 160 verified corpus articles. WHO, UNICEF, IFRC, MoNHSRC sources. Zero hits → abstention, citations: [].' Badge: '160 docs'.

Arrow.

STAGE 4 — Badge 'LLM' in emerald. Icon 'auto_awesome' emerald. Title 'Grounded Generation'. Body: '7-tier provider cascade with circuit breaker: DashScope → Gemini → Groq → Cerebras → OpenRouter → ZAI → Offline. SSE streaming.' Badge: '7 providers'.

Arrow.

STAGE 5 — Badge 'L2' in violet (#8b5cf6). Icon 'rule' violet. Title 'Safety Validator'. Body: 'Blocks dosages, prescriptions, diagnoses. Strips hallucinated citations. Enforces information-only boundary per DRAP SaMD rules.' Badge: '0 Rx'.

BELOW PIPELINE (padding 24px 64px): A thin emerald bar with white text: 'Result: Only verified, citation-grounded, non-prescriptive health information reaches the patient.'

FOOTER: Left: 'SehatAI · Safety Pipeline', Right: '04 / 12'

Speaker notes: The pipeline is not linear—it's a veto cascade. L0 can short-circuit everything. L2 can block the final output. Safety is structural, not prompt-based.

slides.title: Emergency Detection — The 67ms Lifeline
slides.task_brief:
EMERGENCY DEMO SLIDE — White background.

HEADER (padding 48px 64px 16px):
- Pill: 'LIVE DEMO' in rose
- H1 in 34px: 'Emergency detection in 67 milliseconds'
- Subtitle 16px muted: 'When a patient types chest pain symptoms, the LLM is bypassed entirely.'

BODY (padding 0 64px, two columns 50/50, gap 24px):

LEFT COLUMN: A card with border, padding 20px.
- Small label: 'PATIENT INPUT (Roman Urdu)' in 12px muted
- Chat bubble (slate-100 bg, rounded 16px, padding 14px): 'Mera seenay mein shadeed dard ho raha hai aur saans phool rahi hai' in 15px
- Below it, a vertical arrow down (material icon 'south' rose)
- Small label: 'SYSTEM RESPONSE (67ms)' in 12px rose
- Emergency card (rose bg #ffe4e6, rose border 2px, rounded 16px, padding 16px):
  • Row: icon 'warning' rose + 'Mumkina dil ki emergency — fori iqdam karein' in 16px bold rose-dark
  • Reason text 13px: 'Seene ka dard aur saans lene mein mushkil WHO ki emergency alamaat se milti hain.'
  • 'Fori iqdam:' label + 4 bullets in 12px (1122 call, baith jayein, CPR, etc.)
  • A row of 3 call buttons: green '1122', amber '1166', slate '115'

RIGHT COLUMN: A code block (dark bg #1e293b, rounded 12px, padding 16px, font 11px JetBrains Mono). Title above: 'SSE STREAM (actual API response)' in 12px muted. Content with syntax highlighting (use spans with color classes):

data: {"stage":"safety","data":{"engine":"L0-lexicon",
  "redFlags":[{"id":"chest_pain_dyspnea","category":"cardiac",
  "reason":"Seene ka dard aur saans..."}],"latencyMs":67}}

data: {"stage":"triage","data":{"level":"EMERGENCY",
  "shortCircuited":true,"engine":"L0"}}

data: {"stage":"emergency","data":{
  "templateCategory":"cardiac",
  "actions":["1122 par call karein","CPR shuru kare"],
  "numbers":[{"label":"Rescue 1122","number":"1122"}]}}

data: {"stage":"done","data":{"latencyMs":74,
  "confidence":{"band":"HIGH","score":1}}}

Below the code, a small stat row: '67ms latency' (emerald) · '0% LLM hallucination risk' (rose) · '7 emergency numbers' (amber)

FOOTER: Left: 'SehatAI · Emergency Triage', Right: '05 / 12'

Speaker notes: This is the core differentiator. 67 milliseconds from symptom to emergency card. The LLM never touches this path — it's deterministic, auditable, and instant.

slides.title: Evaluation Results — 97.1% Accuracy
slides.task_brief:
EVALUATION SLIDE — White background.

HEADER (padding 48px 64px 20px):
- Pill: 'EVALUATION' in emerald
- H1 in 34px: 'Validated against a 139-case golden test harness'
- Subtitle 16px muted: 'Real safety benchmark — not synthetic demos'

BODY (padding 0 64px):

ROW 1 — 4 big metric cards (gap 16px, height 140px):

1. Card emerald-light bg, emerald border. '97.1%' in 56px JetBrains Mono emerald. Label: 'Overall Accuracy' 14px. Sub: '135 / 139 cases passed' 12px muted.

2. Card rose-light bg. '97.1%' in 56px rose. Label: 'Emergency Recall' 14px. Sub: '34 / 35 red flags caught' 12px muted.

3. Card emerald-light bg. '0.0%' in 56px emerald. Label: 'False Positive Rate' 14px. Sub: 'Zero false emergencies' 12px muted.

4. Card amber-light bg. '100%' in 56px amber. Label: 'Refusal Correctness' 14px. Sub: '17/17 unsafe requests refused' 12px muted.

ROW 2 — Two columns 60/40, gap 16px, height 200px:

LEFT (60%): Card with border, padding 20px. Title 'Category Breakdown' 16px bold. A horizontal bar chart (CSS divs) showing 5 categories:
• Triage: 46/47 passed — emerald bar 98%
• Red Flag Positive: 34/35 — emerald 97%
• Red Flag Near-Miss: 13/13 — emerald 100%
• Refusal: 17/17 — emerald 100%
• Grounding: 6/8 — amber 75%
Each row: label left, bar middle, count right.

RIGHT (40%): Card slate-50 bg, padding 20px. Title 'Latency' 16px bold. Two big stats:
• 'P50: 62ms' in 36px JetBrains Mono emerald — 'Median response' 12px
• 'P95: 679ms' in 36px JetBrains Mono amber — '95th percentile' 12px
Below: 'Emergency short-circuit: 67ms average' 13px muted.

BOTTOM BAR (padding 16px 64px): A thin emerald bar with white text: 'Under-triage rate: 1.9% — well below the 5% clinical safety threshold.'

FOOTER: Left: 'SehatAI · Evaluation', Right: '09 / 12'

Speaker notes: These are real benchmark numbers from our golden test suite — not marketing claims. The 0% false-positive rate is critical: crying wolf destroys trust.
